title.zh: 授权Mindanao Agricultural College组建并运营农业及相关学科之研究部门并为此拨款的法案
title.en: An Act to Authorize the Mindanao Agricultural College to Organize and Operate a Research Department in Agriculture and Related Subjects, and to Appropriate Funds Therefor
title.orig: An Act to Authorize the Mindanao Agricultural College to Organize and Operate a Research Department in Agriculture and Related Subjects, and to Appropriate Funds Therefor

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 4 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1961/ra_3066_1961.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: The Mindanao Agricultural College shall organize, equip, and operate a research department in agriculture and related subjects and disseminate valuable information for the proper guidance of students, farmers, and homemakers.
To implement this Act, the sum of one hundred thousand pesos is hereby appropriated out of any funds in the National Treasury not otherwise appropriated as aid to the Mindanao Agricultural College.
Hereafter, all necessary funds with which to operate and maintain the research department herein authorized to be established shall be provided for in the annual General Appropriation Acts.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: June 17, 1961.
